Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Sukhraj Singh
Message:
Add real TOTP two-step verification and gate deletion on it

RFC 6238 (HMAC-SHA1, 6 digits, 30 s, +/-1 step) with AES-GCM storage under a
key derived from ZONATA_AUTH_SECRET, single-use steps and a five-failure
lockout. Enrollment is explicit: setup returns a one-time secret and otpauth
URI, enable proves a code, disable needs the password and a current code.

Deletion identity now checks the password first and then a real code:
TWO_STEP_NOT_ENROLLED (409), TWO_STEP_REQUIRED (400), INVALID_TWO_STEP_CODE
(403) and TWO_STEP_LOCKED (429) replace the old 501 refusal. The deletion
sheet enrolls in place when needed and the Security screen reads real server
state instead of a local switch.

Migration 0012 is additive with a manual rollback. Login-time MFA is still
not enforced; the tracker records that limit.
